questions.content: Two identical parallel plate capacitors, of capacitance C each, have plates of area A, separated by a distance d. The space between the plates of the two capacitors, is filled with three dielectrics, of equal thickness and dielectric constants K1, K2 and K3. The first capacitor is filled as shown in fig.I, and the second one is filled as shown in fig II. questions.content: A sample of an ideal gas is taken through the cyclic process abca as shown in the figure. The change in the internal energy of the gas along the path ca is –180 J. The gas absorbs 250 J of heat along the path ab and 60 J along the path bc. The work done by the gas along the path abc is:
questions.explanation:
For the process (c – a), Uca = – 180 J

For process (b – c) Isochoric (Wbc = 0)

U = 60 J

Heat absorbs along (a – b), Qab = 250 J

Also Ucycle = 0

Uab = 120 J

So Wa b = 130 J

Total work done from (a b c)

= Wab + Wbc = 130 J

questions.explanation:
In (CH3)3N, one lone pair and 3 sigma bond present. So it's shape is pyramidal.

But in (SiH3)3N, due to backbonding lone pair of N shift to vacant 3d orbital of Si. So now N have only 3 sigma bond and hybridization is sp2, that is why it has triangular planar geometry.

As in (SiH3)3N. nitrogen(N) don't have any lone pair to donate but in (CH3)3N, lone pair of nitrogen(N) can easily be donated. That is why (CH3)3N is more basic.
